mechanism: Rivastigmine increases cholinergic activity which may enhance levodopa's effects and increase risk of adverse effects including nausea, vomiting, and syncope; potential additive effects on CNS and GI motility.
action: Monitor for enhanced levodopa side effects (nausea, vomiting, orthostatic hypotension, syncope) and adjust doses if needed; monitor for GI tolerability and blood pressure changes.
